name: Zul'Gurub: Hakkar's Blood Siphon drains every 2 s for its 20 s (#8448)
contract: Hakkar (14834) casts Blood Siphon (2118615) 90 s into the fight: a 3 s cast (SpellCastTimes 14) and a
channel of up to 60 s (SpellDuration 3) that applies a dummy aura to Hakkar himself (effect 1, caster target).
The script drains every player every 2 s for SIPHON_LENGTH 20 s, and each drain adds one stack of Anemia
(2118623, 2.5 s duration from SpellDuration 66, up to 100 stacks), refreshing it. Drains at +2 to +18 s give
9 stacks. The drains run while Hakkar channels, and the siphon ends his channel at 20 s instead of 60 s.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub
CONTROL: Hakkar casts Blood Siphon 90 s into the fight, after its 3 s cast
DISCRIMINATING: the drains at +2 to +18 s stack Anemia 9 times on the hero
DISCRIMINATING: the siphon ends Hakkar's channel at 20 s, not after the full 60 s
CONTROL: the hero survived the fight
